*       Sort lt_method_calls in a way, that methods contained in
*       lt_leads are executed first.
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM sort_method_calls
              USING    lt_leads           TYPE cts_aims
              CHANGING lt_method_calls    TYPE trmtd_method_calls.

  DATA: lv_leads_ind      TYPE i,
        ls_lead           TYPE cts_aim,
        ls_method_call    TYPE trmtd_method_call.

  DESCRIBE TABLE lt_leads LINES lv_leads_ind.

* loop at lt_leads in inverse order.
* Do not generally sort table lt_method_calls, since there is some
* pre-ordering in CTO_ORDER_GET_METHOD_CALLS.
  WHILE lv_leads_ind GT 0.
    READ TABLE lt_leads INDEX lv_leads_ind INTO ls_lead.
    READ TABLE lt_method_calls WITH KEY
      method    = trmtd_after_imp
      method_fb = ls_lead-name
      INTO ls_method_call.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.  "entry exists: shift to first place.
      DELETE lt_method_calls INDEX sy-tabix.
      INSERT ls_method_call INTO lt_method_calls INDEX 1.
    ENDIF.
    SUBTRACT 1 FROM lv_leads_ind.
  ENDWHILE.

ENDFORM.         " SORT_METHOD_CALLS

    clear: actopts.
* act_id: id of activation process (guid)
    actopts-act_id = proto_handle.
* act_user: username
    actopts-act_user = control_user.
* act_date: date of activation
    actopts-act_date = act_date.
* act_time: time of activation
    actopts-act_time = act_time.
* act_system: system id of activation system
    actopts-act_system = act_system.
* act_client: client id of activation client
    actopts-act_client = act_client.
* contr_syst: system id of system where the activation was startet from
    actopts-contr_syst = control_system.
* rc_activ: status of activation process
    actopts-rc_activ = rc_activ.
* dialog: Y=dialog, N=background (default)
    if activation_type = 0.
      actopts-dialog = answer_yes.
    else.
      actopts-dialog = answer_no.
    endif.
* with_messg: ' '=do not write status messages at end of activation
*             'E'=write status messages at end of activation except
*                 of 'e'-type messages
    actopts-with_messg = with_message.
* task_syst: transport number of system transport
    actopts-task_syst = task_number_syst.
* task_cust: transport number of customizing transport
    actopts-task_cust = task_number_cust.
* simulat_on: Y=simulation, N=activation (default)
    if simulation_on is initial.
      actopts-simulat_on = answer_no.
    else.
      actopts-simulat_on = answer_yes.
    endif.
* unchecked: Y=expert mode, N=standard mode (default)
    if complete_only = 2.
      actopts-unchecked = answer_yes.
    else.
      actopts-unchecked = answer_no.
    endif.
* actlinks: Y=write+transport , W=write only ,N=nothing
    actopts-actlinks = actlinks.
* no_standrd: N=activate all data (default), F=activate fix values only
    if no_standard is initial.
      actopts-no_standrd = act_all.
    else.
      actopts-no_standrd = no_standard.
    endif.
* transp_off: Y=write all data and transport no data at all,
*             N=data activation and transport due to system and client
*               settings (default)
    actopts-transp_off = transport_off.
* sysedt_off: Y=ignore productive system/client check
*             N=consider productive system/client check (default)
    actopts-sysedt_off = sysedit_off.
* safety: Y=activate data only if bcsets and objects do not show errors
*         N=activate as much data as possible (default)
    actopts-safety = safety.
* call_from: flag describing the caller (see SCPREXTCONST)
    if call_from is initial.
      actopts-call_from = cf_unknown.
    else.
      actopts-call_from = call_from.
    endif.
* upgr_mode: Y=system is in upgrade mode

    if upgrade_mode is initial.
